qualification_scope: Benchmark-reference visual discriminator alignment, not full correctness of diagnosis or clinical adjudication. Unknown reference cases contribute only executable trace/cost/failure evidence.

similarity_audit.limitation: Aligned grayscale thumbnail screen can miss cropped, rotated, mirrored or recompressed duplicates; similarity is not patient identity.

reference_rule: Only source-aligned visual discriminators receive benchmark agreement; no independent clinical adjudication; causal or management clauses are not established.
scope: Source-learning only; image-only duplicate audit covers reserved images against existing pool, without evaluation questions or targets.
